name: Waymo Open Dataset Benchmark
description: A large-scale autonomous driving benchmark based on the Waymo Open Dataset, containing high-quality LiDAR and camera recordings from diverse driving scenes for evaluating perception and prediction systems.
evaluation_method: task-specific leaderboard metrics, commonly mAP and mAPH for detection, plus tracking and prediction metrics depending on the subtask
notes: Multiple benchmark tracks exist over time, including detection, tracking, and motion prediction. Scores are usually reported on a public leaderboard with standardized evaluation code.
